caption: Medieval towers, San Gimignano
composition: Tower-house skyline above terracotta rooftops · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the fields below, the tourist faces San Gimignano's famous stone towers rising above the terracotta rooftops, their faces catching the first golden light. The town glows warm against a lavender dawn sky, with cypresses and pale buildings on the left and dark olive-green trees filling the foreground. At 07:05 the windows still burn amber while daylight creeps across the hilltop.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the medieval towers of San Gimignano at twilight
